name: traffic_path
title: Where YUME traffic goes
summary: yume carries application traffic to yumed's front door. A valid admission proof reaches an authenticated YTP/1 session and its policy check. Anything else gets the cover website.

nodes.title: yume
nodes.note: Collects traffic from applications and sends it to the server inside one long-lived connection that looks like a browser visiting a website.

nodes.title: Front door
nodes.note: Answers every request without a valid admission proof from the static website, so a scanner sees an ordinary site.

nodes.title: YTP/1 session
nodes.note: Both identities are proven with Ed25519 and ML-DSA-87, and the session keys mix X25519, ML-KEM-1024, the client's access PSK and the TLS connection.

nodes.title: Policy check
nodes.note: Each stream names a service. yumed checks that this client may use it and that every address of the destination is allowed before it opens a socket.

nodes.title: Cover website
nodes.note: The operator's own static site, loaded when yumed starts. There is no built-in fallback site.
